Catch-up for da50ae8 ("A dangling edge was accepted, stored, and reported by nothing"), which changed graph.rs to REFUSE an edge naming an id nobody created — matching what snapshot_node and add_change_event already did. The design held: req:no-silent-fallback already said this and the code was brought to meet it, so there is no design meaning to record. Same class as chg:accept-a2a035876eefa13a.

FOUND BY THE GATE BEING RED, not by anyone noticing: da50ae8 landed without the reconcile, so main's CI has failed on this one finding for three commits (runs of 2026-07-29 03:33, 03:47, 03:54, all "workspace + real-binary instruments"). The registered checksum was also the full 64-char digest where every sibling registers 16 — harmless, since reconcile truncates the observation to the registered dialect, but it is why the mismatch reads oddly.
